parameters.jsCode: const isPlainObject = (value) => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value); const envelope = $json; if (!isPlainObject(envelope) || !isPlainObject(envelope.body)) { throw new Error('read-only contract rejected'); } const input = envelope.body; const inputKeys = ['operation', 'idempotency_key', 'evidence_partition', 'synthetic_subject_id', 'commercial_snapshot']; const snapshotKeys = ['renewal_window', 'engagement_band', 'commercial_evidence_state', 'consent_state']; const allowed = ['ordinary', 'boundary']; if (Object.keys(input).length !== inputKeys.length || !inputKeys.every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(input, key)) || input.operation !== 'read_renewal_context' || typeof input.idempotency_key !== 'string' || input.idempotency_key.length < 16 || input.idempotency_key.length > 128 || !allowed.includes(input.evidence_partition) || typeof input.synthetic_subject_id !== 'string' || !/^subject-[a-z0-9]+$/.test(input.synthetic_subject_id) || !isPlainObject(input.commercial_snapshot) || Object.keys(input.commercial_snapshot).length !== snapshotKeys.length || !snapshotKeys.every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(input.commercial_snapshot, key) && typeof input.commercial_snapshot[key] === 'string')) { throw new Error('read-only contract rejected'); } const facts = snapshotKeys.map((key) => `${key}.${input.commercial_snapshot[key]}`); return [{ json: { operation: input.operation, idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key, status: 'read', facts } }];
